questions.question: When was insulin glargine first started, and at what dose?
What were the glucose readings before this week, and were there any patterns or trends?
Was the instruction to double insulin tonight documented in any prior clinical decision or order, or is it solely from the patient-reported AI nurse summary?
Has the patient's insulin regimen been adjusted recently, and if so, what was the rationale and timing?
Are there any documented hypoglycemic episodes or safety concerns related to insulin use in the past month?
What clinical assessments (e.g., HbA1c, renal function, weight) support or inform current insulin dosing?
